company.name: CData Software
company.shortDescription: CData Software is a software company that offers data integration solutions for real-time access to applications, databases, and Web APIs.
company.description: CData Software offers data integration solutions for real-time access to on-line or on-premise applications, databases, and Web APIs. It specializes in providing access to data through established data standards and application platforms such as ODBC, JDBC, ADO.NET, OData, SSIS, BizTalk, and Excel.
company.headquarters: Chapel Hill, North Carolina, United States

productsAndServices.description: An integration platform for electronic data interchange, managed file transfer, and business-to-business data exchange workflows.
